name: daxuan-science-assets
review_cadence: After scientific or visual feedback, workflow or image-backend changes; otherwise quarterly
upstream_inspiration: Rimagination/scansci-svg; lgwrightlab/schematic-figure; K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills; qiaomu-meta-skill; daxuan-image-relay; skill-creator

intent.job_to_be_done: Create generated raster scientific assets or transparent native SVG objects and source-traceable methodology schematics, with explicit evidence and QA for the selected delivery mode.
inputs: Optional reference image or existing SVG
Supplied papers, inspected methods, figures or supplements
Preliminary idea, proposed adaptation, and figure scope/size/detail budget
Reference-author colors and the destination figure, with explicit color meanings or author palette reports
outputs: Generated PNG/JPEG when image-first delivery is requested
Editable transparent SVG when vector delivery is requested
Transparent PNG preview for native SVG mode
Methodology semantic plan and source/evidence map when applicable
Verified local source extracts and reproducible base diagram when applicable
Color context, source snapshots and palette/contrast checks when reference or target colors matter
Attributed aesthetic candidate review and thumbnail/placement previews when appearance is part of the request
Attributed single-image review with localized findings, preserved strengths and actual-slot evidence
Optional assembled PDF with retained original text/vector objects, exact native label, actual-slot preview and bounded-change evidence
exclusions: Invented methods, mechanisms, citations or results
Raster-only photorealism without a bounded scientific brief

evidence_boundary.native_svg_tooling: Existing native vector tools and three bundled fixtures remain unchanged; source-selection and alpha checks are covered by current tests.
evidence_boundary.image_provider: Historical active-relay generations and reference edits saved verified transparent PNGs. Current source availability is checked per request; no live official-host generation is established.
evidence_boundary.publication: GitHub main update 0.7.0; no new tag, registry release or deployed service. Earlier versioned release evidence retains historical scope.
evidence_boundary.trigger_routing: 28/28 English lexical smoke cases; not measured model-routing accuracy
evidence_boundary.local_install: Historical 0.5.0 installation remains in install-evidence.json; current publication installation is recorded in publication-checks.json.
evidence_boundary.methodology: One primary-paper excerpt-to-SVG example (Love et al., 2014), with verified local extract hashes and quotation containment, plus one authored idea fixture. Native output reproduces from the explicit plan; agent source/visual review only, not an independent scientific benchmark.
evidence_boundary.color_context: Local paint/raster inspection and color-decision checks pass 12 focused tests. A two-material local revision passes alpha, source, role-lock and geometry checks, with agent slot/full-figure inspection; no independent perception benchmark.
evidence_boundary.aesthetic_review: Agent inspection of real candidate/refinement assets for one screen-time topic and standalone single-image reviews of a person scene and a public pipette fixture. Hash/schema checks do not certify beauty, human preference, science or journal acceptance. Non-square comparison previews preserve aspect ratio; applicability gates follow explicit background and composition mode.
evidence_boundary.pdf_assembly: Actual clean vector figure and synthetic multipage/non-square-source replays preserve original drawings/text/page boxes and match outside declared overlay regions at the recorded DPI. Inserted illustration remains raster; unknown publication width and other renderer behavior remain outside these checks.
